title: Good Time Charters

services.name: spot dolphins
services.desc: Step aboard for a 90-minute or 3 hour journey through the scenic waters of Estero Bay, where dolphins play, seabirds soar, and every moment brings you closer to nature. Our spacious 28-passenger catamaran offers a more intimate and comfortable experience than larger tour boats, giving you unobstructed views and plenty of room to relax. Guided by a licensed master captain and knowledgeable naturalists, this cruise is perfect for families, couples, solo travelers, and friends looking to enjoy the beauty and wildlife of Southwest Florida - with a little more peace and a lot more personality. services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Set out on one of our unforgettable sunset cruises and experience Estero Bay as it comes alive in the golden hour. Whether you’re watching dolphins play, spotting rare birds, or collecting seashells on a peaceful barrier island, every cruise offers a personal and scenic escape from the crowds. With a maximum of 28 guests on board, our spacious power catamaran ensures unobstructed views, expert insights from certified naturalists, and a relaxed, intimate atmosphere you won’t find on larger tour boats.
